entries.name: dng02-left-flight-state
entries.rationale: Optional DNg02/L tonic-rate hypothesis: 35 Hz matches the measured 0.70635 hover-power trim per DNg02 cell; scenario and state terms are explicit engineering calibration, not fitted FlyVis output.

entries.name: dng02-right-flight-state
entries.rationale: Optional DNg02/R tonic-rate hypothesis paired with DNg02/L; the opposite heading-error sign provides a bilateral steering differential without injecting spikes directly.

provenance.fitted_output: signed T4/T5 activity deviation from the steady-state grey-screen baseline
provenance.calibration_basis: 50 consecutive raw FlyVis frames, not a one-frame amplitude fit

sustained_response.summary: Rounded extrema from the continuous 50-frame raw FlyVis trace; the bound leaves finite headroom and rejects out-of-contract values.

provenance.gain_basis: identity gain: the sustained raw response already spans approximately -0.726 to +0.860 mV/ms; the old 4096x one-frame fit would saturate this trace
provenance.operating_reference: The +/-1.0 mV/ms output bound is an engineering safety envelope with explicit clipping, not a biological measurement
provenance.tonic_state_reference: neuromuscular_map.json hover trim is 0.70635 wing power; 35 Hz per DNg02 cell is an explicit tonic-rate hypothesis for the real CSR, not a fabricated spike train
